The sequence opens with a low-angle frontal tracking shot. Two hoverbikes race side by side at extreme speed along a gigantic circular elevated track. Both riders lean low over their vehicles while the bikes subtly compete for position. Their hover engines spin rapidly, orange-red energy trails stream from the rear, and clouds of dust and mist rise from the track. At the 3-second mark, the white hoverbike on the right aggressively pushes toward the left. The red hoverbike immediately pushes back. Their side armor panels collide violently at high speed. Both vehicles shake heavily but remain intact, while the riders grip the handlebars tightly and struggle to maintain balance. At the moment of impact, use a cinematic cut to an extreme close-up of the collision point. The camera stays very close to the contact area as the metal armor panels grind and press against each other. Subtle scratches and dents appear across the vehicle surfaces. A large shower of orange-yellow sparks and a small amount of metallic debris fly toward the camera. The shot briefly enters high-speed slow motion, clearly revealing the rapidly spinning wheels, vibrating mechanical components, compressed suspension parts, and the impact force traveling through the riders arms. Add subtle camera vibration to emphasize the power of the collision. Then cut back to a low-angle wide tracking shot. The two hoverbikes violently rebound from the collision, sway from side to side, and quickly regain balance. The red bike briefly scrapes against the edge of the track, producing a continuous trail of sparks, while the white bike accelerates and gains a half-bike lead. In the final moment, both bikes accelerate again and race side by side toward the depths of the futuristic city. Cinematic science-fiction action film, realistic metallic materials, intense sensation of speed, natural motion blur, volumetric fog, high-speed cinematography, powerful physical impact, cool gray environment contrasted with bright orange sparks, smooth and coherent motion, ultra-detailed, widescreen composition. Shot Timing: - 0–3 seconds: Low-angle frontal tracking shot; both bikes race side by side and compete for position. - 3–4 seconds: The white bike pushes left, causing a violent side collision. - 4–6.5 seconds: Extreme close-up of the collision in slow motion, showing grinding metal and flying sparks. - 6.5–8 seconds: Cut back to a wide shot; the bikes rebound, sway, and recover. - 8–10 seconds: Both bikes accelerate and race deeper into the city. Negative Prompt: Additional vehicles or riders, two bikes merging into one, intersecting geometry, clipping, vehicle teleportation, incorrect collision point, complete explosion, vehicles suddenly breaking apart, changing number of wheels, riders being thrown from the bikes, deformed bodies, distorted limbs, hands separating from the handlebars, continuously changing bike structures, missing collision subject in the close-up, sparks covering the entire frame, excessive debris, uncontrolled camera rotation, extreme camera shake, sudden environmental changes, melting background, flickering image, texture flickering, low resolution, cartoon appearance, text, subtitles, watermark, logo. What is Vidu? Vidu is a cutting-edge AI video generator that transforms text and images into high-quality videos, supporting multiple creation modes: Text to Video, Image to Video, and Reference to Video. Designed for independent creators and teams, Vidu simplifies the production of high-quality videos, 2D animations, and diverse artistic styles, empowering users to bring their creative visions to life effortlessly. With robust semantic understanding and fast generation speed, Vidu eliminates production complexities, allowing creators to focus solely on their ideas. From low resolution to stunning 1080p outputs, Vidu offers unmatched flexibility and efficiency, providing a broader canvas for creativity. What is the use of Vidu AI? Vidu AI is a powerful tool for creating high-quality AI-generated videos with exceptional consistency and fast generation speed. It is widely used across various industries, from social media content creation to professional video production and commercial advertising. Many creators use Vidu AI to produce viral videos like kissing, hugging, or fighting clips. Film studios and animation teams leverage it for studio-level 2D animations and cinematic content. Businesses also use Vidu AI to enhance marketing videos, such as image-to-video to animate product images or reference-to-video to change ad backgrounds, making video advertisements more dynamic and engaging. With its advanced AI capabilities, Vidu AI streamlines video production for creators, studios, and businesses. What s the difference between Vidu s Reference to Video and Image to Video? Image to Video: Vidu s Image-to-Video feature allows users to create AI-generated videos from a static image, bringing them to life with motion and animation. Users can also set the first and last frames of their AI video. It streamlines the video or animation creation process—often leading to surprising and creative results. Reference to Video: Reference to Video lets users upload three or more images of an object, character, or scene as references, and Vidu can combine elements into a seamless video based on a prompt. Vidu s Reference to Video also supports uploading different angles of a character or object to ensure consistency. Vidu also offers the My References feature, allowing users to save characters, props, and scenes for effortless reuse, enhancing both creative efficiency and video quality. This feature is ideal for maintaining consistency and seamlessly generating videos that blend multiple visual references. Is Vidu AI free to use? All users receive a set amount of free credits to generate videos at no cost. Is Vidu AI safe to use? Yes, Vidu AI is completely safe to use. We prioritize user data security and privacy, ensuring all uploaded content remains confidential. Vidu does not share or leak personal information. Our system is designed with robust security measures to protect your data at all times. For more details on how we handle your information, please refer to our Terms of Use.
